budget: S$500 a month on POEMS, from December 2026

rules.title: Buy every month
rules.text: New money goes in each month whatever the trend says.

rules.title: Trend rules decide exits only
rules.text: US holdings follow the S&P 500 dual rule. SGX holdings follow the STI 10-month average. China A holdings follow the Shanghai 10-month average. Signals are read on month-end closes.

rules.title: Exit means all cash
rules.text: When a market's rule flips from in to out at a month end, sell holdings there and keep SGD cash on POEMS until it flips back in.

rules.title: Take profit
rules.text: Up 30% or more and analyst upside under 10% (or Morningstar 1-2 stars): sell half and reinvest.

rules.title: Replace a loser
rules.text: Down 25%, below its 200-day average and cut to hold: replace it.

fees: POEMS Cash Plus: US 0 commission with fractional shares; SGX 0.08% with no minimum; China A 0.12% with a CNH60 minimum and 100-share lots; dividend fee 1%, minimum S$1.
